name: Celtor Commander Helm
desc: Despite being a realm built primarily on commerce, the city of Celtor also possessed many long-standing military traditions, now lost to time. But, by candle light, among the Celtorian diaspora, some still recall their fragments, many generations since. These embers of history survive through word of mouth and recollection. Tales of valiant knights in shining armour, of glorious quests, of honour and virtue. Yet, what kernels of truth remain in these stories, diluted by the salt-brine of time?
